hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Maintain a neutral, reduced-risk posture. The cross-asset regime is risk_on, but most established signals are flat-to-negative and conviction is modest. The long signals for ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, XLM, and ETC are especially fragile because they share identical outputs with zero volatility, expected shortfall, alpha, and liquidity inputs, suggesting a fallback or incomplete-data condition rather than robust evidence. UNI is also fragile due to high volatility, weak liquidity, negative alpha, and near-zero composite strength; DOGE is additionally weakened by very poor institutional and liquidity
